legal_issue: Whether a business is entitled to financial compensation for lost income following the revocation of its operating permit without prior notice or an opportunity to respond, in the absence of a public safety emergency.
relevant_facts: A business held a valid operating permit.
A public authority revoked the permit before its expiry.
The business received no prior notice.
The business was not given an opportunity to respond.
No immediate public safety emergency was identified.

authorities.case_name: Mock Business Association v. Public Authority
authorities.relevance_to_issue: Establishes that a public authority must ordinarily provide reasonable notice and an opportunity to respond before revoking a permit unless an emergency exception applies; however, it does not address financial compensation or damages for lost income.
authorities.judicial_treatment_summary: Followed by MOCK_SC_004 on 2025-01-15 regarding general procedural fairness in permit revocation.
authorities.authority_assessment: Current and reliable authority (good law) establishing procedural fairness requirements under Section 10 of the Mock Fair Administrative Procedure Act, but silent on financial remedies.

authorities.case_name: Mock Emergency Authority v. Permit Holder
authorities.relevance_to_issue: Addresses immediate permit suspension without prior hearing in situations involving imminent and serious danger to public safety; does not address non-emergency revocations or entitlement to financial compensation.
authorities.judicial_treatment_summary: Distinguished by MOCK_SC_005 on 2023-02-10 for non-emergency permit revocations.
authorities.authority_assessment: Partially invalidated authority whose emergency exception remains potentially relevant, but it was distinguished for non-emergency decisions and contains no rule on financial compensation.

authorities.case_name: Mock Traders Union v. Licensing Board
authorities.relevance_to_issue: Historically permitted revocation without prior hearing whenever administratively appropriate, but does not provide for financial compensation.
authorities.judicial_treatment_summary: Expressly overruled by MOCK_SC_006 on 2024-06-01 regarding permit revocations without procedural safeguards.
authorities.authority_assessment: No longer good law; cannot be relied upon as valid authority for permit revocation procedures or remedies.
